attributes.board_name: New York State Board of Pharmacy (NYSED Office of the Professions)

rules.alternatives: Licensure requires national certification (PTCB or NHA), but keeping it is not required for registration renewal; NYSED suggests maintaining it as one way to meet the professional-competence duty in Regents Rule § 29.1(b)(9).
rules.notes: Registration renews every three years (aligned to the birth month after a prorated first renewal) without a CE requirement: NYSED's technician pages and FAQ list no continuing education for registered pharmacy technicians (CE applies to pharmacists).
rules.rule_quote: While national certification is not required for registration renewal purposes, §29.1(b)(9) of the Rules of the Board of Regents requires licensees to be professionally competent in the tasks which they perform.
